_comment: Placeholder. Real connections.json is generated when the Service Bus API connection is created (via the Azure portal or `az resource create --resource-type Microsoft.Web/connections`) — it contains a connection ID and must NOT be committed. Rename to connections.json locally after deploying and fill in the values. Note: email no longer goes through a managed connector — Send_..._Email actions call the send-email Azure Function endpoint directly over plain HTTP (Azure Communication Services under the hood), specifically because that connector needs an interactive OAuth sign-in that can't be scripted, unlike the Service Bus connector below which authenticates with a connection string.
